definitions.explanation: For plants, hair, or teeth to emerge and develop.

examples.english: Teeth have started to come in.

notes:
{生|は}える means for something to grow or sprout naturally.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Pair: {生|は}やす (transitive - to grow, let grow)

WHAT CAN {生|は}える:
- {草|くさ}が{生|は}える: grass grows
- {歯|は}が{生|は}える: teeth come in
- {髭|ひげ}が{生|は}える: beard grows
- {髪|かみ}が{生|は}える: hair grows
- カビが{生|は}える: mold grows

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜が{生|は}えている: ~ is growing (state)
- 〜が{生|は}えてきた: ~ has started to grow

HOMOPHONE DISTINCTION:
- {生|は}える: to grow (plants, hair, teeth)
- {映|は}える: to look good, to stand out
